sloka: ततः सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात् समुत्थिताम् ।वायसः सहसा ऽ ऽगम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे ।। ५.३८.२२।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ suptaprabuddhāṁ māṁ rāmasyāṅkāt samutthitām ।vāyasaḥ sahasā ' 'gamya vidadāra stanāntare ।। 5.38.22।।।।

translations.english: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.
